name: Chunked-Geometric IS + CISPO Recovery
tagline: Geometric-mean IS over 16-token chunks with straight-through gradient, dual-clip, and a 50/50 CISPO-style REINFORCE recovery on clipped tokens.

key_hyperparams.name: recovery blend
key_hyperparams.role: weight between clipped PPO and CISPO recovery on clipped tokens

init_recovers: Token-level PPO when C=1 and recovery blend=0
diff_from_baseline: Vs token_level / sequence_level / first_k_tokens: replaces per-token IS with geometric-mean IS over fixed 16-token chunks (intermediate granularity), uses straight-through to keep token-level gradients, and on clipped tokens splices in a CISPO-style REINFORCE recovery term scaled by the detached clipped ratio so clipping never zeros gradient.

name: NEPD-IS: Position-Decay Reweighting
tagline: Per-token IS multiplied by exp(-γ·t/T) normalized so the sequence mean is 1, then standard PPO clipping.
diff_from_baseline: Vs token_level: replaces uniform IS weighting with a normalized exponential position decay so early reasoning tokens get larger gradients and late tokens are downweighted; gradient is routed via a straight-through estimator on (r·d̃ + sg[r]·(1-d̃)).

name: Prefix-Anchored Mixed-Granularity PPO
tagline: Each token's log-ratio is interpolated between its own value and the masked-mean of the first 32 tokens, with mix weight increasing with position.

key_hyperparams.name: anchor_k (K)
key_hyperparams.role: prefix length used to compute the anchor log-ratio

diff_from_baseline: Vs first_k_tokens: instead of detaching the IS gradient for t≥K, late tokens still receive live gradient but through a forward value that linearly mixes the local log-ratio with a prefix-anchored masked-mean over the first K=32 tokens; the mix weight grows with position toward 1.0 over a 96-token horizon, with floor 0.1.

name: PAC-IS: Position-Aware Confidence Blend
tagline: Per-token confidence cw=exp(-β·t/T) blends token-level ratio and sequence-level (geometric-mean) ratio; standard dual-clip PPO follows.
init_recovers: Token-level at β=0; sequence-level as β→∞
diff_from_baseline: Vs token_level / sequence_level: defines a position-dependent confidence cw(t) = e^{-β·t/T} that smoothly interpolates between per-token IS (early) and per-sequence geometric-mean IS (late); blended ratio enters the standard dual-clip PPO with token-mean aggregation, no straight-through.

name: Position-Decayed Token×Segment Mix
tagline: Mixes per-token and 16-token segment-mean log-ratios in log-space with weight α=exp(-0.05·t).
formula: $$\log r_t = e^{-\beta t}\,\log r^{\text{tok}}_t + (1-e^{-\beta t})\,\log r^{\text{seg}}_t,\quad r^{\text{seg}}_t = \exp\!\big(\tfrac{1}{|S(t)|}\sum_{s\in S(t)} \rho_s\big)$$

key_hyperparams.name: SEGMENT_LENGTH
key_hyperparams.role: tokens per segment for masked-mean log-ratio

init_recovers: Token-level IS at β=0; segment-level IS as β→∞
diff_from_baseline: Vs token_level: forms a per-token convex log-space mix between token-level and 16-token-segment masked-mean log-ratios; mixing weight α(t) decays with absolute position (not normalized by sequence length) at exp(-0.05·t), then dual-clip PPO is applied.
